sentence: This project holds a meeting where researchers, clinicians, patients and families share knowledge and data about a rare platelet disorder.
This project uses tandem mass spectrometry on cancer cells, tumor tissue and biological fluids to look for pathways and drug targets in cancers.
This project builds interference screws that copy bone and ligament tissue using 3D printing, to help bone and tendon regenerate at the same time.
This project tests whether targeting an immune evasion factor of the virus can reduce genital herpes lesions and viral shedding.
This project builds wearable cameras that use computer vision to identify medications during drug preparation, to help prevent giving the wrong drug.
This project studies how vaginal microbiota and genital inflammation affect HIV infection in women living in sub-Saharan Africa.
This project studies how N-terminal acetylation affects the amount of alpha synuclein protein, which is linked to Parkinson's Disease.
This project studies how gut microbiota from undernourished mothers with environmental enteric dysfunction affects fetal development, using gnotobiotic mouse models.
This project combines several sequencing methods on core-needle biopsies to map gene regulatory networks in triple-negative breast cancer.
This project tests whether somatic mutations cause temporal lobe epilepsy and looks for the cell-types and gene expression changes involved.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that read clinical photographs and microbiologic smears to find the cause of infectious keratitis.
This project builds methods to study prenylated proteins, a class of proteins that control many key events within cells.
This project studies how the neuropeptide vasoactive intestinal peptide is released during sensory learning and changes cortical circuit dynamics.
This project follows an aging group of men and women with and without HIV to study how HIV and substance use affect organ function.
This project studies how amygdala-prefrontal circuits work during fear extinction learning in humans, in relation to post-traumatic stress disorder.
This project tests how a variable-stiffness orthosis that stores and returns energy can help with foot drop by assisting dorsiflexion.
This project builds optical coherence tomography methods to measure retinal blood flow speeds at the capillary level in diabetic retinopathy.
This project screens chemical compounds to find small molecules that block the secretion systems Mycobacterium tuberculosis needs to grow and cause disease.
This project builds software that handles instrument methods and quantitative analysis of mass spectrometry data on proteins.
